story: Americans can legally download 3-D printed guns starting next month
text: Interesting! There are videos: [VIDEO] [LINK] Of course firearms were made in pre-industrial times, and it's fascinating to see how: (just how do you chamber a gun accurately by hand?) [LINK] But how would a technologically savvy first world person do it? These days you can buy a "gunsmithing" lathe for your garage workshop. Check out this video by Shiraz Balolia, CEO of Grizzly Industrial (they sell Chinese made industrial equipment to home shop machinists): [LINK] I was going to link to Joe Pieczynski's excellent machining videos on how to make an AR-15, but it looks like there are new YouTube guidelines: [LINK] In any case, the information is widely available (and check out his other videos if you want improve your machining skills).
